positions.title: "The Mix" Intern
positions.description: During the summer, I gave tours of a newly created technology-based teen center to patrons, and also facilitated various maker workshops held at the center, where I taught youths technological skills that I had learned  myself during the job training.

positions.title: De Young Museum Ambassador
positions.locationName: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
positions.description: I had a few months of training that involved learning about the background and culture of the art pieces that came in with the new exhibit, "The Girl With The Pearl Earring", at the De Young Museum. Afterwards, I was sent as a part of a team to introduce the exhibit to elementary school classes before they took a field trip to the museum. My job was to give enough background information to allow the students to fully enjoy the exhibit while building their excitement for the field trip.
